HOME SCIENCE MARCH — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
